title: EplanMcp pack manifest (pack.json), schemaVersion 1

schemaVersion.description: The manifest format. A reader refuses a version it does not know instead of guessing.

id.description: The pack's identity: lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by '.' or '-', such as acme.cabinet-base.

version.description: The pack's version, SemVer 2.0.0. An installed version never changes; a change is a new version.

eplanVersions.description: EPLAN versions as comparators that must all hold, such as '>=2026.0 <2027'; a version without an operator matches by prefix ('2026.0' is every 2026.0.x). Absent: not stated.

variants.description: EPLAN variants, as EPLAN names them (/Variant:), such as 'Electric P8' or 'Pro Panel'. Empty: not stated.

capabilities.description: What the pack needs from EplanMcp or EPLAN: capability catalog ids (catalog/, such as A:backup/PROJECT) or tool names.

compatibility.description: Where the pack can be used.

version.description: The versions accepted: comparators that must all hold, such as '^1.2.0', '~1.2.0', '>=1.2.0 <2.0.0', '1.2.3' or '*'.

dependencies.description: Other packs this one needs; pack.lock.json records the exact versions resolved. Sorted by id.

path.description: The path in the pack, '/' between folders. A project's path is its link file (.elk, .ell, .elr); its data folder <name>.edb lies beside it and belongs to the same resource.

subtype.description: A finer kind where EplanMcp knows one, such as window_macro, page_macro or plot_frame.

sha256.description: SHA-256, lowercase hex. A file: of its bytes. A project: of the lines '<path>\t<bytes>\t<sha256>\n' of its files (link file and data folder), paths relative to the link file's folder with '/', sorted ordinally. EPLAN's lock files (*.lck) are no part of a project; its session files User.eod and User.eox travel with it but are not hashed, nor counted in bytes and files, because EPLAN rewrites them on open, export and close.

bytes.description: The size in bytes; a project: all its files together.

files.description: The number of files: 1, or a project's hashed files with the link file.

root.description: The root's name in config.json packSources.

path.description: The path below the root, '/' between folders; no drive, no '..', no EPLAN variable.

reference.description: Where a referenced resource lies; only and always for storage 'referenced'.

input.description: The input's name, as provenance.inputs lists it.

path.description: The path below that input, '/' between folders; empty when the input is the file itself.

source.description: Where the resource came from: an input of provenance.inputs and the path below it. Never a local absolute path, so a pack can be shared.

eplanVersion.description: The EPLAN version the files say they were written with, when EplanMcp can read it without EPLAN; the evidence is in facts.

items.description: A file, or an EPLAN project (link file and data folder), in the pack.

resources.description: Every file and project in the pack, sorted by path. EPLAN files are stored unchanged.
Paths of resources in this pack.

company.description: One configuration scope, such as a cabinet type, and the resources that configure it.

items.description: One configuration scope, such as a cabinet type, and the resources that configure it.

configuration.description: Configuration by scope, from the widest to the narrowest. Only the slots exist so far; what a scope may configure comes with the M6 design.

path.description: The resource's path in this pack.

note.description: What it is for, in a few words.

items.description: A resource given a role in the pack.

mappings.description: Material mapping files: the company's material numbers against EPLAN parts.

workflows.description: Workflow files; reserved until a workflow format exists.

acceptanceSamples.description: Finished projects that show what the pack's results should look like.

resource.description: The resource's path in this pack.

name.description: What was read, such as eplan_version or archive_format.

evidence.description: Where it was read, such as 'ProjectInfo.xml property 10088'.

items.description: A value EplanMcp read from a resource's files.

facts.description: What EplanMcp read from the resources' own files, with the place it was read. Facts are measured, never inferred.

createdBy.description: The program that generated the manifest, such as 'eplanmcp 0.1.0'.

author.description: The engineer, when given; never filled in from the Windows account.

createdAt.description: When the manifest was generated, UTC.

name.description: The last part of the path given, unique among the inputs; never the full local path.

items.description: A file or folder given to build the pack.

inputs.description: The files and folders the engineer gave, by name only.

provenance.description: Who made the pack, when, and from what. The only place a manifest holds a time.

description: The manifest of an EplanMcp engineering pack (pack.json at the pack's root). EplanMcp generates it; nobody writes it by hand.
